mod.name: New terrains
mod.description:
Expands the adventure map with 11 distinctive terrains:



• Dead Land

• Fields of Glory

• Fiery Land

• Heather Thicket

• Ice Sheet

• Pasturage

• Plateau

• Shallows

• Spoiled Land

• Stardust

• Terrace
mod.deadlandterrain.name: Dead Land
mod.deadlandterrain.description: A cursed land of withered soil, graves, and restless silence, well suited to Necropolis and Death Valley realms.
mod.deadlandterrain.death-valley-connect: Allows the Death Valley faction to claim Dead Land as its native homeland.
mod.fieldgloryterrain.name: Fields of Glory
mod.fieldgloryterrain.description: A crimson battlefield where old victories and forgotten graves still shape the ground beneath marching armies.
mod.fierylandterrain.name: Fiery Land
mod.fierylandterrain.description: A scorched volcanic realm of lava flows, ash, fire, blackened stone, and trees burned by endless heat.
mod.heatherthicket.name: Heather Thicket
mod.heatherthicket.description: A moonlit wilderness of dense heather, dark woods, quiet lakes, and hidden paths beneath a cold night sky.
mod.heatherthicket.grove-connect.name: Grove connector
mod.heatherthicket.grove-connect.descrip: Allows the Grove faction to treat Heather Thicket as its natural wild homeland.
mod.icelandterrain.name: Ice Sheet
mod.icelandterrain.description: A frozen expanse of snow, ice, crystal pools, and harsh northern trails where only the hardy endure.
mod.icelandterrain.hota-connector.name: HotA connector
mod.icelandterrain.hota-connector.descri: Blends selected HotA adventure map objects naturally into the frozen Ice Sheet wilderness.
mod.icelandterrain.tartarus-connector.de: Allows the Tartarus faction to march through Ice Sheet as its native frozen domain.
mod.meadlandterrain.name: Pasturage
mod.meadlandterrain.description: A gentle pastoral country of green grazing fields, soft hills, scattered trees, and quiet rural roads.
Allows the Mythology faction to call the peaceful Pasturage countryside its native land.
mod.meadlandterrain.ruins-connector.name: Ruins connector
mod.meadlandterrain.ruins-connector.desc: Allows the Ruins faction to settle naturally among the open fields of Pasturage.
mod.plateaulandterrain.name: Plateau
mod.plateaulandterrain.description: A rugged highland of windswept cliffs, rocky paths, sparse growth, mines, and exposed battle grounds.
mod.plateaulandterrain.refugee-connect.d: Allows the Refugee faction to find its native refuge among the harsh Plateau heights.
mod.shallowsterrain.name: Shallows
mod.shallowsterrain.description: A coastal world of bright shallows, reefs, corals, lonely islands, sea rocks, and hidden trenches.
mod.shallowsterrain.abyss-connect.name: Abyss connector
mod.shallowsterrain.abyss-connect.descri: Allows the Abyss faction to rise from the Shallows as from its native waters.
mod.spoiledland.name: Spoiled Land
mod.spoiledland.description: A blighted wasteland poisoned by toxic rivers, cracked earth, dead growth, lava scars, and ominous ruins.
mod.spoiledland.farrieryconnect.name: Farriery connector
mod.spoiledland.farrieryconnect.descript: Allows the Farriery faction to thrive amid the smoke and corruption of Spoiled Land.
mod.stardustterrain.name: Stardust
mod.stardustterrain.description: A dreamlike star-lit land of glowing rivers, strange mushrooms, celestial dust, and quiet arcane wonders.
mod.terraceland.name: Terrace
mod.terraceland.description: A serene terraced country of sakura, bamboo, clear lakes, carved cliffs, and eastern garden paths.
mod.terraceland.retreat-connect.name: Retreat connector
mod.terraceland.retreat-connect.descript: Allows the Retreat faction to make the calm terraces its natural homeland.
